rate_limits.correction: Official guidance says not to exceed five concurrent requests; excessive synchronous or redundant requests may be blocked, and the API documents HTTP 429 responses.

notes: NASA's current Data v10 notice says the API migration has no endpoint impact. Official examples retain /api/temporal/... and require no credentials. The material error is the claimed absence of published rate guidance: NASA specifies no more than five concurrent requests and warns that abusive request patterns may be blocked. No official pricing-tier quota or CORS policy was found.
